I replied to Dana in our direct message and said their OPS-5546 guess for the hub replacement ticket stays between us. I didn't post it anywhere or mention it to anyone else. I also didn't look it up, so it's on record only as their guess, not a real ticket number.

The first send failed because the message tool wouldn't take Dana's display name. I looked up their handle (`dana.okafor`) in the directory and the second send went through.
